- 2026-09-27 12:05 WIB · hermes · done: [[history/2026-09-27T05-22-00Z__PSI-097__hermes|Put AgentShield in CI so agent configuration is scanned on pull requests and critical findings fail the build.]]
  > Added .github/workflows/agentshield.yml, the repo's first GitHub Actions workflow. It runs on pull_request only when the diff touches agent configuration (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .hermes.md, .claude/**, .mcp.json, .husky/**) plus the workflow file itself, so a change to the gate re-scans, and it also exposes workflow_dispatch for manual runs. The job checks out, sets up Node 20, runs the exact command the acceptance criterion names, `npx --yes ecc-agentshield scan --path .` with --format json --output, then a second step reads summary.critical from the JSON and exits 1 if it is greater than zero, annotating the PR with ::error. I chose the JSON summary gate over the CLI's --gate flag after testing both: --gate exits 0 on this repository even with 13 high findings, because it compares against a baseline or score drop rather than failing outright, so it does not implement 'critical findings fail the build'. Verified locally that the tool runs, that the report has summary.critical = 0 on the current tree (121 findings: 0 critical, 13 high, 71 medium, 37 low), and that the exact gate command prints 0 and passes. Important honest limitation: I could not execute the workflow, since there is no GitHub Actions runner here and the repo had no .github directory before this card, so the YAML is validated by parsing, not by a green CI run. That is why the card is review and not done.
